id: 05_BIOSAFETY WORKING IN A BIOLOGICAL SAFETY CABINET
title: 生物安全：在生物安全柜中工作
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/05_BIOSAFETY WORKING IN A BIOLOGICAL SAFETY CABINET.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/05_BIOSAFETY WORKING IN A BIOLOGICAL SAFETY CABINET/src.py

points.K14: 废物桶三分之二满就封口

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台生物安全柜旁，柜门前窗半开，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biological safety cabinet with its front sash half open and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天进生物安全柜，学规矩。
overlay: 生物安全：在生物安全柜中工作

shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍柜体侧面
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the side of the biological safety cabinet and smiles.
shots.narration: 它是实验室里的防护主力。

shots.scene: 阿杰端着样品盒走向生物安全柜，手里还拿着酒精灯
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks toward a biological safety cabinet carrying a sample box and an alcohol burner.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次用生物安全柜分装样品。

shots.scene: 阿杰把东西一股脑堆在台面前沿
shots.prompt_en: The young male student piles tubes, tip boxes and a waste bin onto the front edge of the cabinet work surface.
shots.narration: 他把东西全堆在柜子门口。

shots.scene: 小研快步走来，抬手示意停下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over and raises her hand to signal stop.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧叫停：先别急！

shots.scene: 老周站在一旁，手里拿着空白规程本
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands nearby holding a blank procedure booklet and nods.
shots.narration: 老周说：这台柜子，有一套规矩。

shots.scene: 五块积木组成的墙，其中“工程控制”那块发光，上面画着安全柜图标
shots.prompt_en: A wall of five building blocks; one block with a biological safety cabinet icon glows brightly. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜，是关键的工程控制。

shots.scene: 安全柜像一面盾牌挡在人和病原之间
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet icon stands like a shield between a person outline icon and a microbe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用设备把危险隔开。

shots.scene: 气流箭头从柜内向下，把操作者和样品都罩住
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a biological safety cabinet with arrows of downward airflow covering both the work area and the operator's hands. No people.
shots.narration: 它同时保护两样：

shots.scene: 左边人员图标带盾牌，右边样品管带盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A person outline icon with a shield on the left and a sample tube icon with a shield on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 保护操作的人，也保护样品不被污染。

shots.scene: 老周翻开空白规程本，上面只有安全柜图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man opens a blank procedure booklet that shows only a biological safety cabinet icon.
shots.narration: 好设备，也要按规程用。

shots.scene: 规程本和安全柜之间画一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure booklet and a biological safety cabinet icon joined by a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 规程是管理控制，和设备配合才安全。

shots.scene: 阿杰随意操作的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person working carelessly at a cabinet with the sash wide open, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 想怎么用就怎么用，不行。

shots.scene: 老李用仪器检测安全柜，旁边一张空白合格标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests the biological safety cabinet with a handheld meter; a blank certification tag hangs on the cabinet.
shots.narration: 每台安全柜，都要定期检测认证。

shots.scene: 日历图标和安全柜图标，日期被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with a circled date beside a biological safety cabinet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按当地监管部门或国家标准来做。

shots.scene: 两台外形不同的安全柜并排
shots.prompt_en: Two biological safety cabinets of different shapes stand side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 不同厂家的柜子，用法不完全一样。

shots.scene: 王老师和老周一起写空白规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man write a blank procedure document together at a desk.
shots.narration: 实验室要编自己的操作规程。

shots.scene: 规程旁边画上对勾和放大镜，表示验证
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure document with a magnifier icon and a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 验证可行后，才正式开工。

shots.scene: 小研从左到右摆放：移液器、吸头盒、样品、废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student arranges items in the cabinet from left to right: pipettes on a stand, a tip box, a sample bottle and a small waste bin.
shots.narration: 柜里的东西，要按顺序摆好。

shots.scene: 一条从左到右的箭头，起点干净、终点是废物
shots.prompt_en: An arrow running from left to right over the items, starting at the clean pipettes and ending at the waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 从干净到污染，一条线走下去。

shots.scene: 交叉的手臂图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of arms crossing over each other above samples, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手不来回交叉，动作才顺。

shots.scene: 带生物危害标志的废物桶，盖子打开
shots.prompt_en: A waste bin with a biohazard warning sign and an open lid inside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 废物桶是专门装锐器和一次性废物的。

shots.scene: 吸头图标旁出现锐器警示
shots.prompt_en: A pipette tip icon next to a small sharp-point warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 在柜里，吸头也按锐器处理。

shots.scene: 小研往废物桶里倒入消毒液，液面到桶高的四分之一
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours disinfectant from a blank bottle into the waste bin until it is about one quarter full.
shots.narration: 废物桶里，先加约四分之一的消毒液。

shots.scene: 一瓶空白标签的酒精消毒液
shots.prompt_en: A bottle of alcohol disinfectant with a blank label next to the waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 这里用的是百分之七十的乙醇。

shots.scene: 规程本和消毒液瓶并排
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure booklet next to the disinfectant bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 用哪种消毒液，按规程指定。

shots.scene: 小研从架上取下移液器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a pipette from the stand inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 操作要一气呵成：取移液器，

shots.scene: 移液器装上吸头
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a pipette being pressed onto a tip in the tip box. No people.
shots.narration: 装上吸头，调好体积。

shots.scene: 从样品瓶中吸取
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws liquid from a sample bottle with the pipette.
shots.narration: 从样品瓶里吸取，

shots.scene: 加到分装板的孔里
shots.prompt_en: She dispenses the liquid gently into the wells of a plate.
shots.narration: 轻轻加到对应的孔里。

shots.scene: 吸头弹进废物桶
shots.prompt_en: She ejects the used tip into the waste bin with disinfectant.
shots.narration: 用完的吸头，直接丢进废物桶。

shots.scene: 动作连贯的流程箭头
shots.prompt_en: A smooth curved arrow linking pipette, tip, sample, plate and waste bin icons. No people.
shots.narration: 动作顺，飞溅和失误就少。

shots.scene: 气流剖面图：顶部向下的气流覆盖台面中部
shots.prompt_en: A side cutaway of the cabinet: clean air flows down from the top over the middle of the work surface and into the grilles. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里有一股向下的气流。

shots.scene: 台面中部画出绿色区域
shots.prompt_en: A green highlighted zone across the middle of the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 在这块区域操作，才受保护。

shots.scene: 小研手臂平稳伸入，不贴前窗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student keeps her arms steady inside the cabinet, working in the middle, away from the front opening.
shots.narration: 手臂平稳，进出要慢。

shots.scene: 气流同时罩住手和样品的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of downward airflow covering both the operator's gloved hands and the open sample bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 这股气流护人，也护样品。

shots.scene: 酒精灯放在柜内，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An alcohol burner flame inside a biological safety cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里不能用明火。

shots.scene: 火焰上方形成旋转的热气流箭头
shots.prompt_en: Swirling hot air arrows rising above a flame icon and breaking the straight downward airflow. No people.
shots.narration: 火焰的热气流，会打乱保护气流。

shots.scene: 阿杰把酒精灯放回柜外
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts the alcohol burner back on a shelf outside the cabinet and nods.
shots.narration: 阿杰把酒精灯拿了出去。

shots.scene: 离心机放在柜内，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge placed inside a biological safety cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 离心机也别放进柜里开。

shots.scene: 离心机散热风扇吹出乱流箭头
shots.prompt_en: Air arrows blowing out from a centrifuge cooling fan and disturbing the cabinet airflow. No people.
shots.narration: 它的散热风扇，会搅乱柜内气流。

shots.scene: 被打乱的气流箭头和打叉的盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Broken, swirling airflow arrows and a cracked shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 保护气流一乱，就护不住人和样品。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套用消毒剂擦拭台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the cabinet work surface with a cloth and disinfectant.
shots.narration: 开工前，用指定消毒剂擦拭柜内。

shots.scene: 关上前窗，柜内紫外灯亮起
shots.prompt_en: The front sash is closed and a violet ultraviolet lamp glows inside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 还可以配合紫外灯去污。

shots.scene: 工作结束后再次擦拭
shots.prompt_en: After finishing, she wipes the work surface and the items again before taking them out.
shots.narration: 用完后，再用同样的消毒剂消毒一遍。

shots.scene: 物品外表面擦过后再移出柜外
shots.prompt_en: She wipes the outside of a sample box before moving it out of the cabinet.
shots.narration: 拿出来的东西，外面也要擦。

shots.section_title: 废物桶三分之二满就封口
shots.scene: 废物桶上画一条三分之二高度的虚线
shots.prompt_en: A waste bin with a dashed line at two thirds of its height. No people.
shots.narration: 废物桶装到三分之二，就要封口。
overlay: 废物桶三分之二满就封口

shots.section_title: 废物桶三分之二满就封口
shots.scene: 小研把废物桶封好口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes and seals the waste bin lid tightly.
shots.narration: 把桶口封好。

shots.section_title: 废物桶三分之二满就封口
shots.scene: 废物桶送往指定地点，箭头指向高压灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries the sealed bin to a designated area; an arrow points to an autoclave icon.
shots.narration: 送到指定地点，高压灭菌或焚烧。

shots.scene: 王老师翻看空白的国家标准文件，上面只有图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a blank standards document with only a biological safety cabinet icon on it.
shots.narration: 编规程时，参考本国和地方的指南。

shots.scene: 规程本上盖章的图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure booklet receiving an approval stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 经过审核，再发给大家用。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现安全柜、规程本、认证标签图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of a biological safety cabinet, a blank procedure booklet and a certification tag.
shots.narration: 按规程使用，定期认证。

shots.scene: 从干净到污染的箭头和绿色工作区
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from clean to dirty items over a green work zone. No people.
shots.narration: 摆放有序，在保护区里操作。

shots.scene: 打叉的火焰和离心机图标
shots.prompt_en: A crossed-out flame icon and a crossed-out centrifuge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里不用明火，不开离心机。

shots.scene: 擦拭、紫外灯、废物桶虚线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of wiping with disinfectant, a small ultraviolet lamp and a waste bin with a two-thirds line. No people.
shots.narration: 用前用后消毒，三分之二满就封口。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰站在整洁的安全柜前一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student stand in front of a tidy biological safety cabinet and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 用好安全柜，护人又护样，再见！
